description:
Simalytics is a focused companion for Simkl that keeps your movies, TV shows, and anime organized in one place.

TRACK YOUR LIBRARY
Browse your watching, completed, planned, on-hold, and dropped titles in clean lists or poster grids. Sort your collection and open rich detail pages for every title.

STAY ON TOP OF EPISODES
Keep track of your next episodes in Up Next. Browse seasons and anime episode ranges, resume from your latest watched season, and mark episodes watched without losing your place.

DISCOVER MORE
Explore today's trending movies, shows, and anime, Top 10 charts, genres, and collections like Hidden Gems and Weekend Binges. Get picks based on the genres you rate highest, add titles to Plan to Watch with a long press, and search the catalog from its own tab.

SYNC WITH SIMKL
Sign in with your Simkl account to sync watchlists, progress, and ratings across devices. Choose your default launch tab, use 5-star or 10-point ratings, blur episode images, or hide anime for a more focused view.

Simalytics requires a Simkl account. Simalytics is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Simkl.
promotionalText: Track every movie, show, and anime in your Simkl library, stay current with Up Next, and discover what to watch from one focused companion.
whatsNew:
• A new Explore tab for browsing: today's trending picks, genre tiles, daily Top 10s, collections like Hidden Gems and Weekend Binges, the best of each streaming service and TV network, and picks by decade.
• For You suggests titles from the genres you rate highest, and a switch hides titles already in your library.
• Long-press any title in Explore to add it to Plan to Watch, watch its trailer, or share it.
• Search now has its own tab, with today's trending titles as quick suggestions.
• Explore stays smooth while it loads, downloads only what changed, and stays readable at the largest text sizes.
